360-1981-2415-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
360-1981-2415-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

4452-5310-6495-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
4452-5310-6495-6879.notes:
If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3682-4574-4659-4750-6842.notablePrerequisites:
There must be at least one +1/+1 counter each on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts.
You control at least one colored legendary creature or planeswalker.
3682-4574-4659-4750-6842.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Flux Channeler triggers, putting one +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts you control.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mox Amber, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mox Amber from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Iron Spider's last ability by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from artifacts you control, drawing Mox Amber.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1183-1477-6972.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Pentavus.
When Pentavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

469-7683.notablePrerequisites: You have another instant or sorcery card in hand with the mana to cast it and applicable target(s) if needed.
469-7683.description:
Cast any other instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Insidious Will by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Insidious Will's storm ability triggers, creating at least one copy of Insidious Will targeting the original Insidious Will.
Resolve a copy of Insidious Will, copying Insidious Will targeting the original Insidious Will.
Repeat step 4.

862-3558-6516-7735.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.

Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

789-997-1580-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

129-1409-5295-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

5702-6753--143.manaNeeded: {2}{G} plus enough mana to animate the land
5702-6753--143.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a land that doesn't have summoning sickness and that can tap to produce at least {G}.
5702-6753--143.description:
Earthbend a land that can tap to produce at least {G}, thus animating it.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated land.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the land it is attached to due to Exalted Sunborn.
When the land tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the two land tokens by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and create two 1/1 Insect creature tokens due to Exalted Sunborn
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the land it is attached to due to Exalted Sunborn.
Repeat from step 5.

3933-4929-5479-7741.notablePrerequisites:
Lost Jitte has at least one charge counter on it.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3933-4929-5479-7741.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion by paying {4}, putting a charge counter on Lost Jitte and two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping Karn's Bastion.
Repeat.

3812-5963-7704.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
3812-5963-7704.description:
Activate Marvin using Doc Samson's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1636-2034-5803-7245.description:
Cast Twist Reality by paying its mana cost.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Twist Reality.
Resolve the copy of Twist Reality, causing you to put a card from your library onto the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature.
When the creature enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the face-down creature, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3

141-1269-2921.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1269-2921.description:
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Exhume.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Exhume
Resolve the Exhume copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2906-6867-6884.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
2906-6867-6884.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

64-972-3542.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
64-972-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is an artifact.
When the Palinchron token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Warden of the Eye by paying its mana cost.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye and the Palinchron token.
When the Warden of the Eye and Palinchron tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
64-972-3542.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Palinchron and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Warden of the Eye instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

339-677-2079-2511.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Temur Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1661-5078-6556.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

2033-4499--85--92.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking the creature that creates creature tokens upon entering the battlefield.
When the creature enters, it triggers, creating at least two creature tokens.
Activate the creature and two tokens by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
2033-4499--85--92.notes: If the creature that creates tokens creates three or more tokens, this combo nets infinite untapped creature tokens. Otherwise, this combo nets infinite tapped creature tokens.

4681-4730-5147-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sparring Mummy, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sparring Mummy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

277-1479-5671-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
277-1479-5671-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and The Necrobloom trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1170-4779-5034-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4779-5034-5131.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sol Ring.
Cast Sol Ring from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha.
Repeat.

465-2079-3742-4251-4452.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-2079-3742-4251-4452.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

An opponent cannot block creatures you control.

969-3259-3986.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Battle Cry Goblin as attackers. If needed, declare more creatures as attackers to ensure that the total power of attacking creatures is 6 or greater.
Battle Cry Goblin triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1409-2883-3263-4659.description:

When Twisted Sewer-Witch enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Twisted Sewer-Witch.
Resolve the Twisted Sewer-Witch trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token, and then creating a Wicked Role Aura token attached to each Rat you control.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Wicked Role token, adding {2}.
The Wicked Role token triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.

1976-3532-5078-5240.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Oneirophage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2232-2421-2459-3735-4050.notablePrerequisites: Rograkh andYou have enough mana to pay for Rograkh's commander tax, if applicable.
2232-2421-2459-3735-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Skyfire Phoenix, adding {W}.
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Skyfire Phoenix enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Keleth to your hand from the battlefield.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Skyfire Phoenix, adding {1}.
Cast Keleth by paying {1}{W}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Skyfire Phoenix enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Rograkh to your hand from the battlefield.
When Keleth enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

423-511-621-3510.notablePrerequisites: Either Sporoloth Ancient or Sporesower Thallid has at least three spore counters on it, with the other having at least two spore counters on it.
423-511-621-3510.description:
Activate either Sporesower Thallid or Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Life and Limb, Evolution Sage triggers, putting a spore counter on Sporesower Thallid and Sporoloth Ancient.
Repeat.

31-212-1068-1654.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
Leveler enters the battlefield, exiling your library.
Cast Lokhust Heavy Destroyer by paying {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Lokhust Heavy Destroyer enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Canoptek Spyder.
Resolve the Lokhust Heavy Destroyer trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature, and you to sacrifice Lokhust Heavy Destroyer.
Resolve the Canoptek Spyder trigger, causing you to return Lokhust Heavy Destroyer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

598-1303-2452-2523.notablePrerequisites: Ratadrabik in hand or in your graveyard.Liliana has at least three loyalty counters on it.
598-1303-2452-2523.description:
Activate Liliana's third ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ratadrabik either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Ratadrabik enters the battlefield, triggering Necroduality, creating a token copy of Ratadrabik.
Put the original Ratadrabik into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each other copy of Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Ratadrabik that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2.

864-2104-4428.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
